snippet.title: Absolute Blue Trailer
snippet.description:
The arcade and shooting games from the 80s and 90s glued me to the screen and growing up as a game developer I found the desire to recreate these experiences for a new generation. Absolute Blue is a classic 2D Shoot’em’up where you pilot a ship and fight your way through waves of enemies and boss battles.

More infos: http://intermediaware.com/games/absoluteblue
